title: Usage-Based Billing Sales Tax: Rules, Credits and Nexus
summary: Learn how sales tax applies to usage-based billing, from nexus and credits to sourcing.

**Stripe Billing**


Meters usage events and totals them at the end of the billing period


Stripe Tax built in; third-party tax apps supported


Teams already using Stripe payments


**Chargebee**


Usage records attached to metered plan items


Built-in taxes plus third-party tax integrations


Subscription businesses adding usage-based pricing


**Zuora**


Usage uploads rated against complex pricing plans


Connects to external tax engines


Large enterprises with complex billing operations


**Maxio**


Metered and event-based components


Third-party tax integrations


B2B finance teams that want built-in revenue reporting


**Orb**


Raw event ingestion with flexible pricing logic


Tax provider integrations, including through Stripe


High-volume API and AI usage


**Recurly**


Usage-based add-ons on subscriptions


Third-party tax integrations


Consumer and recurring billing businesses


**Lago**


Open-source, event-based metering


Tax integrations and API


Teams that want an open-source or self-hosted option
